The work covers designing and automating the build, migrating databases and server-level objects, and cutting over with minimal downtime, delivered in planned migration waves. This is a fixed six-month engagement with no extension. All migration work, documentation and knowledge transfer must be complete within the contract period. Phase 
 Timeline 
 Focus Phase 1

Contribute to wave plans, runbooks, rollback plans and cutover checklists, and provide downtime estimates for each instance. Azure VM build and post-build configuration Work with the infrastructure team on VM sizing, managed disk layout (data, log, tempdb), VNet/NSG, availability zones and storage performance. Install and configure SQL Server to the standard build: collation, MAXDOP, cost threshold, max server memory, tempdb layout, Instant File Initialization, Lock Pages in Memory, service accounts/gMSA and trace flags where needed. Configure Database Mail, SQL Agent alerts and operators, and maintenance jobs (backups, CHECKDB, index and statistics maintenance). Migrate server-level objects: logins (with SIDs), permissions, jobs, linked servers, credentials, certificates, operators and server configuration. Handle TDE certificates and keys securely, and fix orphaned users. Validate data after migration (row counts, checksums, application smoke tests) and share the evidence with the Senior DBA for sign-off. Take part in shadowing and walkthrough sessions with the permanent DBA team in the final month, and hand over scripts and procedures. Support decommissioning of the old servers.
